replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Well that was rude...
Unless you somehow are on a plane playing on Avicus, your internet goes to shit or someone decides to ddos you, your ping shouldn't go too far from the ping you checked before logging in... Max 10-15ms change.
Because since it's the time your internet connects to the servers, it shouldn't be changing from 20 to 1000 unless you change your location drastically in a few seconds.
